PonyToolboxMatting.description: Remove backgrounds with local INSPYRENET or FeyNoBg models and output RGBA, mask, and mask preview.

backend.tooltip: Select the local INSPYRENET or FeyNoBg model.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: Image batch whose background should be removed.

sensitivity.tooltip: Adjust mask contrast; 1.0 keeps the model prediction.

mask_offset_percent.name: Mask Offset Percent
mask_offset_percent.tooltip: Offset based on megapixel-equivalent image length; positive expands, negative contracts. Default -0.1%.

mask_feather_percent.name: Mask Feather Percent
mask_feather_percent.tooltip: Feather after offset using a Gaussian radius based on megapixel-equivalent image length. Default 0.07%.
